title: Internet of Things and Machine Learning for Healthy Ageing: Identifying the Early Signs of Dementia.
summary: In a monitored older-adult cohort, machine-learning analysis of smart-home activity patterns was used to identify dementia onset, with classification accuracy reported by the study. The result is bounded to the monitored sample and does not establish general clinical screening performance.
ai_technology: Machine-learning classifiers analyzed smart-home activity features to detect dementia onset.

evidence.unknown: The detection result is limited to monitored older adults and the reported validation; broader screening performance and clinical benefit are not established.
